items.title: Bank of Maharashtra net rises 35% on robust loan growth
items.description: Bank of Maharashtra announced a strong net profit of ₹2,014 crore for the fourth quarter of FY26. This represents a significant 35% jump from the previous year. The bank saw robust loan growth, particularly in retail, agriculture, and MSME sectors. Net interest income also rose considerably. Looking ahead, the bank anticipates continued credit and deposit growth in FY27.
